content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [product_name] ([version_no]) on my controller [product_name] - [article_no] with firmware [version_no]. Overall, it functions decently, though I find [product_name] rather limited. My main issue is with the 'keep me logged on' feature, which only works intermittently. When I enter the address [url], I briefly see the requested page before being redirected to the login screen almost immediately (with the 'keep me logged on' box checked but without the password field filled). I've tested this with Windows 10 and Firefox [version_no], an Android device with Firefox, and Microsoft Edge—all show similar behavior. Occasionally, using my bookmark gets me directly to the page, but other times I'm redirected after about one second. I've tried clearing all cookies connected to the address but no luck so far. Any suggestions? Best regards, [user_name]

Hi [user_name], This could be related to your controller's limitation that only allows a single active user session. If you access it from another browser or device, existing sessions may be invalidated, requiring a new login. Best wishes, [user_name] (translated by Google)

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are experiencing inconsistent behavior with the 'keep me logged on' feature in [product_name], where login sessions aren't reliably maintained. Occasional successful direct page access alternates with frequent redirects to the login screen, regardless of browser or operating system. A restriction to one active session for the controller seems to contribute to confusion and dissatisfaction among users seeking a more stable experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the 'keep me logged on' function to consistently preserve their login session, enabling smooth and repeated access to their desired pages without needing to reauthenticate.
